organization_read.name: organization_read
organization_read.using:
id = nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid or coalesce(current_setting('app.platform', true), '') = 'on' or id in (select m.organization_id from organization_memberships m
    where m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid and m.status = 'active')

membership_read.name: membership_read
membership_read.using: organization_id = nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid or user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid

inventory_movements_quantity_sign.name: inventory_movements_quantity_sign
inventory_movements_quantity_sign.value:
("inventory_movements"."type" = 'entry' and "inventory_movements"."quantity" > 0)
        or ("inventory_movements"."type" in ('exit', 'loss') and "inventory_movements"."quantity" < 0)
        or ("inventory_movements"."type" = 'adjustment' and "inventory_movements"."quantity" <> 0)
        or "inventory_movements"."type" = 'count'

inventory_movements_counted.name: inventory_movements_counted
inventory_movements_counted.value:
("inventory_movements"."type" = 'count') = ("inventory_movements"."counted_quantity" is not null)
        and ("inventory_movements"."counted_quantity" is null or "inventory_movements"."counted_quantity" = "inventory_movements"."balance_after")

customers_consent_date.name: customers_consent_date
customers_consent_date.value: ("customers"."marketing_consent" and "customers"."consent_at" is not null) or (not "customers"."marketing_consent" and "customers"."consent_at" is null)

inventory_reservations_status_dates.name: inventory_reservations_status_dates
inventory_reservations_status_dates.value:
("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'active' and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is null and "inventory_reservations"."consumed_at" is null)
        or ("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'released' and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is not null and "inventory_reservations"."consumed_at" is null)
        or ("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'consumed' and "inventory_reservations"."consumed_at" is not null and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is null)

stock_transfer_items_received_range.name: stock_transfer_items_received_range
stock_transfer_items_received_range.value: "stock_transfer_items"."quantity_received" is null or ("stock_transfer_items"."quantity_sent" is not null and "stock_transfer_items"."quantity_received" >= 0 and "stock_transfer_items"."quantity_received" <= "stock_transfer_items"."quantity_sent")

cash_movements_reason.name: cash_movements_reason
cash_movements_reason.value: "cash_movements"."type" not in ('supply', 'withdrawal') or "cash_movements"."reason" is not null

cash_movements_reference.name: cash_movements_reference
cash_movements_reference.value: "cash_movements"."type" not in ('sale', 'refund') or ("cash_movements"."reference_kind" is not null and "cash_movements"."reference_id" is not null)

cash_sessions_status_fields.name: cash_sessions_status_fields
cash_sessions_status_fields.value:
("cash_sessions"."status" = 'open' and "cash_sessions"."closed_at" is null and "cash_sessions"."counted_amount_cents" is null and "cash_sessions"."expected_amount_cents" is null and "cash_sessions"."difference_cents" is null)
        or ("cash_sessions"."status" = 'closed' and "cash_sessions"."closed_at" is not null and "cash_sessions"."counted_amount_cents" is not null and "cash_sessions"."expected_amount_cents" is not null and "cash_sessions"."difference_cents" is not null)

sale_items_amounts.name: sale_items_amounts
sale_items_amounts.value: "sale_items"."unit_price_cents" >= 0 and "sale_items"."discount_cents" >= 0 and "sale_items"."total_cents" >= 0 and ("sale_items"."unit_cost_cents" is null or "sale_items"."unit_cost_cents" >= 0)

sale_payments_cash.name: sale_payments_cash
sale_payments_cash.value: "sale_payments"."method" <> 'cash' or ("sale_payments"."tendered_cents" is not null and "sale_payments"."tendered_cents" >= "sale_payments"."amount_cents" and "sale_payments"."change_cents" = "sale_payments"."tendered_cents" - "sale_payments"."amount_cents")

sales_completed_fields.name: sales_completed_fields
sales_completed_fields.value: ("sales"."status" in ('completed', 'cancelled')) = ("sales"."number" is not null and "sales"."completion_key" is not null and "sales"."completed_at" is not null and "sales"."cash_session_id" is not null)

fiscal_documents_authorized_fields.name: fiscal_documents_authorized_fields
fiscal_documents_authorized_fields.value: "fiscal_documents"."status" <> 'authorized' or ("fiscal_documents"."access_key" ~ '^[0-9]{44}$' and "fiscal_documents"."number" is not null and "fiscal_documents"."protocol" is not null)

inventory_count_items_counted.name: inventory_count_items_counted
inventory_count_items_counted.value: ("inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" is null) = ("inventory_count_items"."counted_at" is null) and ("inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" is null or "inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" >= 0)

inventory_count_items_movement_counted.name: inventory_count_items_movement_counted
inventory_count_items_movement_counted.value: "inventory_count_items"."movement_id" is null or "inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" is not null

inventory_counts_status_fields.name: inventory_counts_status_fields
inventory_counts_status_fields.value:
("inventory_counts"."status" = 'open' and "inventory_counts"."approved_at" is null and "inventory_counts"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("inventory_counts"."status" = 'approved' and "inventory_counts"."approved_at" is not null and "inventory_counts"."approval_reason" is not null and "inventory_counts"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("inventory_counts"."status" = 'cancelled' and "inventory_counts"."cancelled_at" is not null and "inventory_counts"."cancel_reason" is not null and "inventory_counts"."approved_at" is null)

imports_done_fields.name: imports_done_fields
imports_done_fields.value: "imports"."status" <> 'done' or ("imports"."confirmed_at" is not null and "imports"."finished_at" is not null)

sales_targets_scope_fields.name: sales_targets_scope_fields
sales_targets_scope_fields.value:
("sales_targets"."scope" = 'organization' and "sales_targets"."region_id" is null and "sales_targets"."store_id" is null and "sales_targets"."salesperson_id" is null)
        or ("sales_targets"."scope" = 'region' and "sales_targets"."region_id" is not null and "sales_targets"."store_id" is null and "sales_targets"."salesperson_id" is null)
        or ("sales_targets"."scope" = 'store' and "sales_targets"."region_id" is null and "sales_targets"."store_id" is not null and "sales_targets"."salesperson_id" is null)
        or ("sales_targets"."scope" = 'salesperson' and "sales_targets"."region_id" is null and "sales_targets"."store_id" is not null and "sales_targets"."salesperson_id" is not null)

commission_statements_status_fields.name: commission_statements_status_fields
commission_statements_status_fields.value:
("commission_statements"."status" = 'calculated' and "commission_statements"."approved_at" is null and "commission_statements"."paid_at" is null)
        or ("commission_statements"."status" = 'approved' and "commission_statements"."approved_at" is not null and "commission_statements"."paid_at" is null)
        or ("commission_statements"."status" = 'paid' and "commission_statements"."approved_at" is not null and "commission_statements"."paid_at" is not null and "commission_statements"."payment_reference" is not null)
        or ("commission_statements"."status" = 'cancelled' and "commission_statements"."cancelled_at" is not null and "commission_statements"."cancel_reason" is not null and "commission_statements"."paid_at" is null)

queue_entries_status_fields.name: queue_entries_status_fields
queue_entries_status_fields.value:
("queue_entries"."status" = 'waiting' and "queue_entries"."salesperson_id" is null and "queue_entries"."started_at" is null and "queue_entries"."finished_at" is null)
        or ("queue_entries"."status" = 'in_service' and "queue_entries"."salesperson_id" is not null and "queue_entries"."started_at" is not null and "queue_entries"."finished_at" is null)
        or ("queue_entries"."status" = 'finished' and "queue_entries"."salesperson_id" is not null and "queue_entries"."finished_at" is not null and "queue_entries"."outcome" is not null)
        or ("queue_entries"."status" = 'abandoned' and "queue_entries"."salesperson_id" is null and "queue_entries"."finished_at" is not null and "queue_entries"."closing_reason" is not null)

queue_entries_assignment.name: queue_entries_assignment
queue_entries_assignment.value: ("queue_entries"."salesperson_id" is null) = ("queue_entries"."assignment" is null) and ("queue_entries"."assignment" <> 'manual' or "queue_entries"."assignment_reason" is not null)

queue_entries_outcome.name: queue_entries_outcome
queue_entries_outcome.value: ("queue_entries"."outcome" = 'sale') = ("queue_entries"."sale_id" is not null) and ("queue_entries"."outcome" <> 'no_sale' or "queue_entries"."closing_reason" is not null)

queue_devices_status_fields.name: queue_devices_status_fields
queue_devices_status_fields.value: ("queue_devices"."status" = 'active') = ("queue_devices"."paired_at" is not null and "queue_devices"."revoked_at" is null) and ("queue_devices"."status" = 'revoked') = ("queue_devices"."revoked_at" is not null)

expenses_status_fields.name: expenses_status_fields
expenses_status_fields.value:
("expenses"."status" = 'open' and "expenses"."paid_on" is null and "expenses"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("expenses"."status" = 'paid' and "expenses"."paid_on" is not null and "expenses"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("expenses"."status" = 'cancelled' and "expenses"."cancelled_at" is not null and "expenses"."cancel_reason" is not null)
